label: ACA employer coverage affordability threshold, as the regulation states it
applies: The threshold all three affordability safe harbors in the section are expressed against
movesWhen: Not established by this corpus. The section states the figure and no indexing rule we hold
note: Published here as what the section states, carefully scoped: all three safe harbors in that section are expressed against this threshold. Nothing in this corpus establishes it as the percentage in force for any particular plan year, and it should not be quoted as though it were. If a decision turns on the number, the number is the first thing to confirm.
author: Aaron Bollinger
